items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His son named Roosevelt Stokes. ... [INTERVIEWER] What was Frank Stokes like? Did he play good?

ctx.x: His son named Roosevelt Stokes. Another boy called Earl Bell. See, all those guys. They real young. They young than we are. See, they didn't know anything. And not to do no good. They liked from under the bus.
What was Frank Stokes like? Did he play good?
